instruction_1_verbatim: SWAP THE FEATURED TREATMENTS, AND MAKE THE PRIMARY TWO EQUAL STEPS. — Email the Council becomes WHITE-ON-GREEN. The featured block inverts: the campaign teal field (the section--teal precedent) carries white text — the ask paragraph, the Email the Council line, and whatever the CTA keeps for fill. The white island goes away; the featured block IS the green panel itself, not a panel inside it. — The Tell Your Story and Sign the Petition tiles become the SAME card style as Report an odor and Donate: white cards, same geometry, same head/body/action grammar, distinguished only by a FAINT BLUE GLOW around them — a subtle border/shadow treatment marking prominence, no fill, no dark teal. All four cards then share one style; the glow is the only difference. The glow's colour must come from the palette or be a justified new token, and it must meet the focus/indicator contrast bar if it ever carries focus. — THE PRIMARY CTA HOLDS TWO STEPS OF EQUAL WEIGHT: (1) Email the Council, (2) Wear green and come to the City Council meeting on Dec 1. Equal weight means equal visual prominence, side-by-side or stacked, your call with a reason. The show-up step's copy is composed from the banner facts (Dec. 1, 6:30 p.m., City Hall Council Chambers, wear green) and flagged as agent-composed. The orange button's fate inside a green panel is your call with a reason; the two steps must not compete.
instruction_2_verbatim: THE ALERT BANNER, WHICH THE OPERATOR SAYS IS STILL MISSING. The feedback-board issue's ask (a banner carrying the Dec 1 meeting and the wear-green ask) was recorded as content work and never dispatched. This leg delivers it: the homepage banner block (banner__meta, where the Dec 1 workshop line lives) gains the show-up ask — come to the meeting, City Hall, wear green — with wording you compose and flag. If the banner treatment needs a site-wide alert strip rather than the homepage block, propose it in the PR with a reason; the operator's phrase 'alert banner' and the issue's wording (an alert for a meeting five days out) both suggest urgency is the point.

as_built.two_steps: .ask-steps grid, two .ask-step children, side by side at 720px and above (1fr 1fr), stacked below.
